title: Apply-form strings now split across two modules that each claim sole ownership; situation.gleam imports both
detail: The F4/F5 strings landed in copy.gleam per the spec, but form_copy.gleam already owns form-section strings and claims all of them. situation.gleam now pulls copy from both homes; future string edits have two candidate modules, inviting the drift both module docs say they prevent.
recommended_fix: Document the division in both module docs (upload/banner copy → copy.gleam, section copy → form_copy.gleam), or move address_cluster_summary into form_copy.gleam beside the other section strings.
